sentences.en: The doctors wore white masks over their mouths and noses.
sentences.zh: 医生们在嘴和鼻子上戴着白色的口罩。

sentences.en: He wore a mask so no one would recognize him.
sentences.zh: 他戴上面具以免被人认出来。

sentences.en: The figures and grotesque masks decorating the modillions are interesting.
sentences.zh: 装饰着模形的图案和怪诞面具很有趣。
